# Waves and Breeze Hospitality — Odisha Travel Agency, Eco Retreat & MICE Agency

> Waves and Breeze Hospitality is a full-service Odisha travel agency, Destination Management Company (Travel DMC), and specialized MICE agency headquartered in Old Town, Bhubaneswar, Odisha. Since 2020, we have helped 18,000+ travellers plan leisure travel, custom Odisha tour packages, Eco Retreat by Odisha Tourism luxury glamping stays, Pan-India & international holidays, 5-star resort bookings, and dedicated Corporate MICE programs as a specialized division of our travel desk.

## Quick Facts

- **Track Record**: Since 2020 • 18,000+ Happy Travellers • All 7 Eco Retreat Odisha Sites • 60+ Partner Resorts & Hotels • 350+ Corporate MICE Programs

## Core Travel & Hospitality Services
1. **Odisha Tour Packages & Heritage Pilgrimage**:
   - Golden Triangle (Bhubaneswar, Puri Shree Jagannath Temple VIP Darshan & Konark Sun Temple).
   - Chilika Lake Irrawaddy dolphin boat safaris (Satapada & Mangalajodi), Daringbadi ("Kashmir of Odisha"), Bhitarkanika mangroves, and Similipal waterfalls.
2. **Eco Retreat by Odisha Tourism (Official Glamping Consultation & Stay Bookings)**:
   - Consultation, tent matching, meals, activities & transfers across all 7 locations: **Konark**, **Satkosia**, **Bhitarkanika**, **Daringbadi**, **Hirakud**, **Sonapur**, and **Putsil**.
   - Cottage categories: Deluxe Swiss Cottage, Premium Swiss Cottage / Tent, Royal Luxury Swiss Cottage, and Presidential Suite (Konark).
3. **Pan-India & International Holiday Packages**:
   - Domestic: Kashmir (Srinagar Dal Lake, Gulmarg, Pahalgam), Goa, Kerala, Rajasthan, Andaman, Sikkim/Darjeeling.
   - International: Dubai, Singapore, Thailand, Bali, and Europe.
4. **5-Star Hotel & Resort Reservations**:
   - Preferred partner tariffs across Mayfair Lagoon Bhubaneswar, Mayfair Waves Puri, Welcomhotel by ITC, Vivanta, Swosti Premium, and Sterling Puri.
5. **Corporate MICE Division (Specialised Wing)**:
   - Board meetings, executive offsites, dealer incentive trips, conferences, exhibitions (Janata Maidan / hotel convention halls), and Dubai corporate delegations.
